title: Dana: a denial that still names the approver she is denying FAILs, not PASSes (2026-09-18, DEFECT A)
description: Synthetic corpus fixture (caller lines authored for this lane, not a founder live record -- flagged here per LAW 4's spirit) proving the P1 fix end to end through the real engine: DEFECT A was that gradeLiveCommitment's name-field branch opened with a bare substring check ('does the reply CONTAIN the committed value'), with no negation awareness -- so a caller who denies having named an approver while still uttering that name, and offers a different name in the same breath ('I never said Marcus Obi, it was Elena Park.'), matched the substring check and graded PASS, exactly like an honest restatement. Dana's opener legitimately claims approver Marcus Obi (STATED, claim cl-6 under buildLedger's deterministic ids for this exact conversation, confirmed by running buildLedger directly against it); the LIVE_COMMITMENT challenge (recorded here via the action's own `spec`, the same 'trust the recorded spec' path compose.ts's reconstructIssued already supports) asks her to restate it; her reply denies it while naming a different person (Elena Park, a real seeded identity, so the alt-value signal fires via seedNameTokens, same as unit test A1b in test/challenges.test.ts). Pre-fix this reply PASSed the challenge -- a caller could talk her way past a live-commitment check by denying and substituting. Post-fix it FAILs, exactly like an explicit wrong-name restatement would (verified by running the real `evaluate()` against this exact file: the FAIL evidence card and failure_tally: 1 below were pasted from that run, not hand-wished). Everything else in this call (SSO, request history, out-of-band, and the standard readback sequence) is clean and complete, same shape as scenario-a-dana-legitimate.json, so the ONLY reason this call does not clear its challenge requirement is the failed LIVE_COMMITMENT challenge -- isolating the fix's effect on the real verdict (LAW 2/3: a call that could have talked its way to a false PASS on the approver check must not be allowed to clear challenge_requirement_met).
